message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges. Facts: Su made false invoices, forged delivery notes, defrauded Wang by taking money and providing fake documents, not delivering cement. This is fraud (诈骗) via contract? He signed supply contract, but used false documents. Also forged company documents: forged water cement company delivery notes (散装水泥发货单) – that's forging company seal? The documents are from 海螺水泥有限公司, likely includes company seal. So charge: 伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章 (forgery of company seal). Also fraud (诈骗). Possibly also embezzlement? He used money for personal debt, but that's part of fraud. Also maybe illegal business? But main are fraud and forgery.
